premise: The forest goes to sleep one light at a time, and the moon climbs up to take the night shift.
inspiration: Lullaby litany (folk goodnight songs that name each thing in turn); the moon as a kind night-watch so the dark is safe.
lesson: Night is safe; someone is always watching over you.

en-US.title: Good Night, Forest
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} The sun is tired. It slides down behind the hill, slow, slow, and the sky turns peach, then pink, then purple. Good night, sun. The flowers {flower:fade-out 0.5 hold} fold their petals one by one, like little hands closing. Good night, flowers. The butterflies {butterfly:fade-out hold} tuck themselves under a leaf. Good night, butterflies. The tall trees rock in the last of the breeze. Creak. Creak. Hush. Good night, trees. Now who will watch over the forest? Look up. The moon climbs over the hill, round and white, and {owl:glow hold} pours silver on every path. I've got this, says the moon. Sleep, says the moon. Far away, one soft voice says whoo. And the forest breathes in, and breathes out, and sleeps. Good night, forest. Good night.

es-ES.title: Buenas noches, bosque
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} El sol está cansado. Se desliza detrás de la colina, despacio, despacio, y el cielo se pone naranja, luego rosa, luego morado. Buenas noches, sol. Las flores {flower:fade-out 0.5 hold} cierran los pétalos uno a uno, como manitas que se recogen. Buenas noches, flores. Las mariposas {butterfly:fade-out hold} se esconden bajo una hoja. Buenas noches, mariposas. Los árboles altos se mecen con la última brisa. Cric. Crac. Silencio. Buenas noches, árboles. ¿Y ahora quién cuida del bosque? Mira arriba. La luna sube por la colina, redonda y blanca, y {owl:glow hold} derrama plata por todos los caminos. Yo me quedo, dice la luna. Dormid, dice la luna. A lo lejos, una voz suave dice uuuh. Y el bosque respira hondo, suelta el aire y se duerme. Buenas noches, bosque. Buenas noches.
